ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system xOy, the lines $l_{1}$ and $l_{2}$ are respectively the graphs of the functions $y=k_{1}x+b_{1}$ and $y=k_{2}x+b_{2}$. Then, what is the estimated solution set for the inequality $k_{1}x+b_{1}>k_{2}x+b_{2}$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $x<-2$, $k_1x+b_1>k_2x+b_2$,\\
thus, the solution set of the inequality $k_1x+b_1>k_2x+b_2$ is $x<-2$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x<-2}$.
